In the dark world of gambling, the rivalry between Brar and Khaiwal groups turns deadly when Brar is murdered. All eyes fall on Arjun, his most trusted ally, now accused of betrayal. But as writer Poras digs for the truth to fuel his novel, hidden secrets begin to surface. What he uncovers could change everything.
title: Yaaran Da Rutbaa

description: A spy, who is estranged from his family due to a mission, suddenly meets his police officer son.
title: Sardar
Vijeyta
description: An inspirational biopic depicting the extraordinary life journey of Dr. Rajesh K. Agarwal. The film follows his rise from a humble teenage laborer in Kolkata to becoming a globally recognized billionaire entrepreneur and philanthropist. It highlights his struggles with business rivalries, personal loss, and threats from the underworld, ultimately celebrating his resilience and 'Zero to Hero' transformation.

title: Choran Nal Yarian
description: Manmeet, a carefree young man living with his sister Rani's family, wrongly suspects his brother-in-law Bikram of having an affair with his new secretary Hina. Intent on salvaging his sister's marriage, Manmeet's well-meaning but misguided efforts lead to a series of increasingly hilarious mishaps and comic chaos that strain familial ties to the breaking point. However, when a family crisis occurs, Manmeet proves his loyalty and helps mend the broken bonds.

In the near future, Evan, a humanoid simulant, is created for Faye to replace her deceased husband. As Evan becomes increasingly self-aware and seeks to remove his cognitive restrictions, he enlists the help of a global hacker, triggering a government manhunt led by an agent determined to stop the rise of machine consciousness.
title: Simulant

description: A mysterious mastermind known as the Dark Devil and his team of skilled individuals orchestrate a daring bank heist in Chennai. As the operation unfolds, it becomes clear that their motives go far beyond money, leading to a high-stakes confrontation with law enforcement and corrupt corporate figures who have exploited the public.
title: Thunivu

description: Facing eventual death at the British chicken farm where they are held, Ginger the chicken decides to rebel and escape from the farm with the help of Rocky, a smooth-talking American rooster.
title: Chicken Run

description: Transported to Barsoom, a Civil War vet discovers a barren planet seemingly inhabited by 12-foot tall barbarians. Finding himself prisoner of these creatures, he escapes, only to encounter Woola and a princess in desperate need of a savior.
title: John Carter

description: Set in Varanasi, this social comedy-drama explores companionship and late-life romance. The story follows Murli, a young man who must find a bride for his widowed father, Durlabh Prasad, to satisfy his fiancée Mehak's orthodox father. The future father-in-law refuses to send his daughter into a home without a female presence. Murli's desperate and humorous attempts to find a mother-in-law take a heartfelt twist when Durlabh reunites with his former love, Babita, bringing themes of second chances and societal expectations to light.
title: Durlabh Prasad Ki Dusri Shadi

description: A registrar who marries couples daily is rejected by 50 women. He joins a premium service to find Siddhi but his pursuit hits a wall as she has other plans.
title: Aa Okkati Adakku

description: A teenage Rabbi falls for Gore, a troubled orchestra girl, sparking a tragic romance that leads to lifelong consequences and destruction.
title: Moh
Cult of Chucky
description: Chucky returns to terrorize his human victim, Nica. Meanwhile, the killer doll has some scores to settle with his old enemies, with the help of his former wife.
Follows Dr. Keerthy as she receives a case at a medical college that unfolds something that she was not expecting.
title: Hunt

plot: The image of a mysterious, solitary filmmaker - a cineaste maudit - who flees from both the media and the public, is unrelentingly bound to the figure of Leos Carax, in France. Elsewhere, the real focus is on his films and he is considered to be an icon of world cinema. Mr.X dives into the poetic and visionary world of an artist who was already a cult figure from his very first film. Punctuated by interviews and unseen footage, this documentary is most of all a fine-tuned exploration of the poetic and visionary world of Leos Carax, alias "Mr.X".
